init_QuestionGenerator: initialize a QuestionGenerator with a seq2seq model path and beam search settings for question generation
generate_question: generate questions from answer context pairs using the QuestionGenerator pipeline with configurable beam size
generate_questions_from_passage_answer_p: batch generate questions from a list of passage answer pairs with progress tracking and scoring
load_question_generator: load and instantiate a QuestionGenerator from a config dictionary with model and generation parameters
batch_iterator: iterate over context answer pairs in batches to create formatted input text for question generation
